root_cause.mechanism: self.fixture is only rebound to the current scene_id at install time (end of a CAL). Training/validation/input captures of the same CAL happen before install, so the driver records the stale fixture (previous scene id, or 'bootstrap-muted' at service start). The model written at install carries the current scene_id. Hence the one-generation lag.

options: A-side minimal metadata fix: bind self.fixture to request.scene_id at the start of the calibration (first hw op of a scene), not only at install. Affects metadata only, not audio, not the identity tuple. Requires a repackage by C and one fresh CAL (~150 s) so a scene with consistent metadata exists; capital script then runs unchanged.
Captain-side alternative: treat capture fixture_id as informational (accept previous-scene/bootstrap values) — but this loosens the CONFIG check, so A did not do it.
a_side_action_taken: No code change, no check loosened, no re-capture. Reported back per instruction.
